title: BATWA v2.4.44 Instant Sign Out & Multi-Account Support
message: Fixed sign out redirection, direct routing to clean login screen, secure token clearing, and update prompt refinement.
features: Instant Sign Out Redirection: Tapping Sign Out immediately routes back to a clean login screen and purges all local session tokens.
Effortless Multi-Account Switching: Allows smooth account switching and testing of new user registrations.
Direct APK & Cloud Sync: Zero update loop, sub-second transfers, and real-time cloud balance synchronization.
changelog: Fixed sign out navigation, clean login redirect, secure token clearing, and build 284 release.
